page.overview:
Who is The Crying Child?

The is the protagonist of Five Nights at Freddy's 4 minigames.

The Crying Child is a small boy with dark brown hair. He wears a black shirt with two grey stripes, and light blue shorts and gray shoes. His face is usually stained with tears.

The Crying Child is portrayed as a very scared and confused boy. He constantly cries whenever his older brother sadistically frightens him. He seems to have a connection with his plushies as he calls them his friends, hinting that he may be lonely. The plushies might be the closest thing he has to companions.

The minigame opens up with "5 days until the party." A scene then appears with a small Fredbear plush. The Crying Child is locked in his bedroom with his plushies. Upon approaching them, he states "These are my friends." After banging on the door several times, he gives up and helplessly collapses down into sobbing, as the Fredbear plush states "Tomorrow is another day."
